records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the three months ended September 30, 2025 were $261,047,000, an increase of $18,773,000 or 7.7% from the three months ended September 30, 2024 net sales of $242,274,000.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To date, we have raised prices to our customers to cover these increased raw material costs and are working with our supply base to prioritize shipments and improve availability of key components.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were positively impacted by $9,033,000 of sales volume and $4,955,000 due to price increases.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our principal raw materials and components purchases were approximately $375 million in fiscal 2025 (or 59% of Cost of product sold) and include steel, consisting of rod, wire, bar, structural, and other forms of steel; electric motors; bearings; gear reducers; castings; steel and aluminum enclosures and wire harnesses; electro-mechanical components; and standard variable drives and controls.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities was $248,000 for the six months ended September 30, 2025 compared to net cash used for operating activities of $1,370,000 for the six months ended September 30, 2024.
